instrument_name: N.J.S.A. 34:11-56.12 Notification to certain employees (gender equity notice), L.2012, c.57, s.1
authority: New Jersey Legislature (lis.njleg.state.nj.us statutes database, updated through P.L.2026 c.50)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers with 50+ employees must post the gender-equity notice (Commissioner's form) and give each worker a written copy (within 30 days of issuance, at hire, annually by Dec 31, on request; e-mail, printed material incl. a pay check insert, or intranet), with signed acknowledgement within 30 days. (c): Commissioner makes it available in English, Spanish and other first languages of a significant number of State workers; 'The employer shall post and provide the notification in English, Spanish, and any other language for which the commissioner has made the notification available and which the employer reasonably believes is the first language of a significant number of the employer's workforce.' MANDATE (Spanish + other available languages). Notice, not the pay statement.
